# ESG Hub

> Open-access ESG encyclopedia by Ascent Partners Foundation: 350+ articles on environmental, social and governance topics, sustainability reporting and climate, in English, Chinese and Hindi, plus curated external resources. Content is available through a public REST API and an MCP server for AI agents.

## For AI agents

- REST API (no auth): https://esg-hub.ascent.partners/api/v1 with `/pages`, `/search?q=...`, `/resources`, `/meta`
- [API documentation](https://esg-hub.ascent.partners/en/developers/api)
- MCP server source: https://github.com/simonplmak-cloud/esg-hub/tree/main/mcp-server (12 tools; read-only: `search_esg`, `search_content`, `get_esg_page`, `list_esg_pages`, `list_esg_resources`, `get_esg_metadata`, `get_term`, `get_related`, `list_frameworks`, `list_industries`; write, token required: `propose_term`, `tag_content`)
- Context7 library ID: `/simonplmak-cloud/esg-hub`

## Site

- [English home](https://esg-hub.ascent.partners/en)
- [Source code](https://github.com/simonplmak-cloud/esg-hub)
